solution_text:

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: "axion" — incorrect; drops the "i" before the final "om", giving "axion".

 

• Option 2: "axom" — incorrect; drops both the "i" and the "o", leaving just "axom".

 

• Option 3: "axiome" — incorrect; wrongly adds a silent "e" at the end.

 

NOTE

 

• Related words: axiomatic, axiomatically.
